## Body

A clean HEAD document does not establish a clean public PR presentation. Separately inspect the complete two-sided diff, full current changed files, title/body, issue comments, review bodies, inline review comments, and complete PR commit messages. Paginate every GitHub collection. Report locations and categories, never matched identifiers or secret values; label removed-line findings with base-version line numbers.

Keep mutable metadata, current source, and immutable history distinct. A forward scrub can pass under C19 while an earlier commit message remains publicly identifying. Disclose that historical-only limit; do not claim history is identifier-free or recommend rewriting it. Use a public-safe squash message under C19. A surviving value in mutable PR text is not a historical-only finding.

This extends the existing public-live-receipts-review-heads note with metadata/history coverage. Evidence: #244 at 9c46a9e869ce47c5ae2975b9e035b5f881bc4ffe; security pass-with-notes output commit 83d8b918e3a35785c47e82e333e6c1a8faa23bfc. Current documents and mutable metadata were clear; an earlier commit-message body retained an identifier, withheld from the verdict.
